name: Speed-up defence game
summary: Live dink rally where one player may speed up any high ball; the defender scores speed-ups blocked back in play.
setup: Both players at the non-volley-zone line, straight across, playing into one half of the court
Live dink rally; the attacker may speed up any ball above net height, aimed low at the defender's paddle side or hip, never at the face
The defender blocks or counters the speed-up back in play; after a speed-up the rally ends and is restarted with a dink
Sets of 10 speed-ups; swap roles after each set; the defender counts speed-ups returned in play
success_criterion: In each set of 10 speed-ups faced, return at least 6 in play
safety_notes: Speed-ups at close range: wear eye protection and aim speed-ups low, never at the face. Stop if in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) Errors under pressure at the line are mostly failed answers to a speed-up; a live game that scores only the defence of speed-ups trains exactly the rallies the AN-07 forced-error share counts. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
